shellCommands.command: cd /workspace && cat next.config.ts && echo "--- app tree ---" && find app -type f | head -50 && echo "--- eval ---" && ls -R __agent_eval__ 2>/dev/null | head -30
cat app/layout.tsx && echo "=== page ===" && cat app/page.tsx && echo "=== tsconfig ===" && cat tsconfig.json
grep -rn "after" node_modules/next/server.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo "--- server.js exports ---"; grep -n "after" node_modules/next/server.js 2>/dev/null | head

ANALYTICS_ENDPOINT=http://127.0.0.1:9911/collect npx next start -p 9910 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &
sleep 1; node /tmp/probe.mjs; echo "=== next server log ==="; cat /tmp/next.log; pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; true
mv app/_probe_bad app/probe-bad && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -10
rm -rf app/probe-bad /tmp/probe.mjs /tmp/next.log && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -8 && echo "=== final tree ===" && find app -type f && git status --short
